claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Under stated correction budgets: gap=o(N^-1/2), bounded-below homogeneous values=o(N^-1), quadratic+coercive gauge=o(logN/N).
claims.comparison: The report counts accepted iterations and fixes the instance/constants. These are asymptotic deductions from M, not uniform oracle complexity or sharp linear/superlinear rates.
claims.techniques: Energy telescoping and monotonicity, superquadratic reciprocal sum, harmonic summation; M primitive rate comparison delegated to root.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: An exact vertical geometric run on u²+|v| has Hk=diag(A,C rho^k), preserving arbitrary tangential A.
claims.comparison: Nonsmooth secant collapse and exact scalar recurrences are established themes. No identical arbitrary-A family found. It disproves a universal tangential inverse-curvature limit, not matrix convergence for all runs.
claims.techniques: Block-invariant unexcited direction; scalar secant update and geometric alternating signs.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: A bounded-below finite convex descending scalar ray contains a nonempty interval of strict AW points except scalar nondifferentiability points; finite full-space bad-ray sets yield differentiable accepted steps.
claims.comparison: The scalar existence conclusion is covered by the older line-search theory. The report uses a tilted-minimum proof and separately imposes the full-space bad-ray condition; keep this distinction explicit.
claims.techniques: Minimize phi(t)-sigma*phi′(0)t, then use convex slope inequalities to the right.
claims.open_search_limits: The identified result or direct specialization is an established match. This audit does not establish the earliest historical origin or exhaustive literature coverage.

claims.statement: Coercive five-piece max(-x,y+z,-y+z,x/4,-z) has an SPD descent ray with no full-space differentiable AW point, even locally after scaling.
claims.comparison: This concerns full-space differentiability; scalar ray differentiability may hold on the flat face. It does not contradict a theorem conditional on an infinite differentiable accepted run.
claims.techniques: Explicit line envelope and disjoint intervals excluded by Wolfe, full-space nonsmoothness, and Armijo.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Every finite convex degree-one homogeneous objective has infinite-run value limit0 or -infinity without bounded steps, iterates, matrices, or finite gradient alphabet.
claims.comparison: No theorem of this full scope was located. Bounded-below and coercive specializations include established Euclidean-norm convergence; common-tilt specializations relate to two-piece work.
claims.techniques: Euler identity, exact Bk energy cancellation and homogeneous correction budget, then M reciprocal divergence.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Full-BFGS weak-Wolfe runs on the Euclidean norm in any finite dimension converge to0.
claims.comparison: This specialization must be credited explicitly; it is not a new positive BFGS result.
claims.techniques: The report has a different energy-based proof route from the published smoothing-extension proof.
claims.open_search_limits: The identified result or direct specialization is an established match. This audit does not establish the earliest historical origin or exhaustive literature coverage.

claims.statement: Any finite-gradient finite-value-limit full-BFGS run has0 in the affine hull of recurrent gradients; consequently common-tilt many-piece infinite runs escape in value.
claims.comparison: No exact recurrent finite-alphabet obstruction without iterate/matrix bounds found. The two-piece finite-termination result is stronger on its particular model and must not be claimed as new.
claims.techniques: Discard finite prefix; separate affine hull by vᵀg=1; telescope vᵀBk v using yᵀv=0.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Finite max-linear zero-value-limit runs have convergent iterates if recurrent gradient span<=2; unbounded-below planar cases satisfy stated iterate dichotomy.
claims.comparison: No general planar many-slope classification found. Directions at infinity and recurrent-rank>=3 zero-value iterates remain outside the conclusion.
claims.techniques: Finite gradient transitions, two-gradient endpoint inversion, opposing-slope cases, exact invariant-subspace lifting.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: For0 in relative interior of the slope hull, every infinite max-linear run converges to the H0^-1 metric projection onto the flat minimizer subspace.
claims.comparison: The selector combines homogeneous value convergence with rectangular lifting. S16 assumes a Lipschitz gradient and gives distance-to-set convergence, so does not prove this nonsmooth metric-selector statement. Precise priority of the algebraic selector remains unresolved.
claims.techniques: Coercivity in the slope span and exact lifted subspace formula.
claims.confidence: moderate for S16 nonmatch; unresolved historical selector priority
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Scalar transported certificate existence exactly equals a bounded eligible-pair derivative quotient, equivalently eligible-pair Lipschitzness on positive bands.
claims.comparison: Transport projection is zero in one dimension. This characterization is specific to the report’s certificate and is not unrestricted smoothness.
claims.techniques: Solve scalar visibility/secant inequalities using W=1/g² and positive-band gradient bounds.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Every finite convex scalar objective with unique minimizer and compact initial sublevel has convergence for any positive-metric differentiable AW run.
claims.comparison: The all-scalar-objective/all-positive-metric statement was not located. The proof is elementary and independent of BFGS; do not promote it as a new BFGS-specific mechanism.
claims.techniques: Armijo summability gives finite path length under positive gap; eventual fixed gradient sign plus Wolfe forces geometric gradient decay.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Shifted quadratic-plus-absolute-value scalar example converges globally while violating certificate feasibility on a band for(c1,c2)=(1/4,1/2).
claims.comparison: No exact example found; the obstruction concerns a sufficient certificate, not convergence. The separate(1/8,1/4) accessibility example is handled by root.
claims.techniques: Explicit small kink-crossing pairs and divergent secant quotient combined with scalar convergence.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Strongly convex h(x)=x²/2+3 sum_j 4^-j(x-4^-j)+ converges for every admissible scalar run but lacks a certificate in every optimizer neighborhood.
claims.comparison: No identical geometric-knot construction found. Bandwise constants cannot avoid fixed-knot divergence: choose the knot first. LO13 §4.2 already uses accumulating corners adversarially against a prescribed line search. Its nonterminating query sequence is different from this certificate obstruction on convergent accepted runs.
claims.techniques: Uniform convergence of hinge series; exact geometric sums; local knot derivatives and eligible crossings. Accumulating-kink adversarial design has the LO13 antecedent; similarity does not establish causal provenance.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.

claims.statement: Any finite nonstationary endpoint/eligible-pair sample admits W=I with freely chosen finite constants, so finite sampling cannot refute continuum certificate existence.
claims.comparison: This is an elementary finite-extremum observation about the report’s quantifiers. It should be presented as a methodological limitation, not broad novelty in numerical certification.
claims.techniques: Positive finite minimum gradient norm and finite sum of curvature quotients.
claims.open_search_limits: No exact match in the primary sources inspected and targeted searches recorded here. This does not establish novelty or completeness of the literature.
